Annotators judged each output for minor hallucinations, major hallucinations, omissions, disfluencies, repetitions and provided a relative ranking.

The annotators assessed the presence of minor hallucinations (mostly typos in named entity names), major hallucinations (output containing fact(s) not supported by the data), omissions (missing information), disfluencies (grammar errors or hard-to-read text) and repetitions (information mentioned twice). Finally, the annotators ranked the system outputs for each example from best to worst, with ties allowed.
